title: Height of Binary Tree
question: How do you compute the height (maximum depth) of a binary tree in Java?
searchIntent: height of binary tree java interview
realWorldScenario: Recursive: height = 1 + max(height(left), height(right)); base case: null → 0.

title: Minimum Depth of Binary Tree
question: How do you find the minimum depth of a binary tree? Why is it trickier than maximum depth?
searchIntent: minimum depth binary tree java interview
realWorldScenario: A node with one null child is NOT a leaf — the min depth must be the depth of the actual leaf node.

title: Diameter of Binary Tree
question: How do you find the diameter (longest path between any two nodes) of a binary tree?
realWorldScenario: At each node, diameter through that node = height(left) + height(right). Track global maximum via a class field.

title: Check Balanced Binary Tree
question: How do you check if a binary tree is height-balanced (height difference ≤ 1 for every node)?
searchIntent: check balanced binary tree java interview
realWorldScenario: Return -1 as a sentinel from the helper if unbalanced; check |heightLeft - heightRight| > 1 at each node.

title: Sum of All Left Leaves
question: How do you compute the sum of all left leaf nodes in a binary tree?
seoKeywords: left leaf sum binary tree java
searchIntent: sum of left leaves binary tree java interview
realWorldScenario: Pass an isLeft flag to the recursive call; add value only when the node is a leaf AND isLeft is true.

title: Path Sum Existence
question: How do you check if a root-to-leaf path in a binary tree sums to a target value?
searchIntent: path sum binary tree java interview
realWorldScenario: Subtract node value from target at each step; return true at a leaf when remaining target equals 0.
